geo.title: Country or region
geo.description: Google Trends geo code, e.g. US, GB, DE, IN, BR, JP, or a US state like US-CA or US-NY.

geos.title: Additional geos
geos.description: Optional extra country or region codes to fetch in the same run (combined and de-duplicated with Country or region).

hours.title: Time window
hours.description: How far back to look. Official windows: past 4 hours, 24 hours, 48 hours or 7 days.

category.title: Category (optional)
category.description: Filter by category name or ID: Entertainment, Sports, Technology, Business and Finance, Health, Games, Politics, Science, Shopping, and others. Leave empty for all categories.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of results before the max-items cap is applied.

maxItems.title: Max keywords
maxItems.description: Hard cap on keywords written and charged in this run.
